summary: Kimi Antonelli inherited the lead when a virtual safety car bunched the field, allowing the Mercedes driver to leapfrog pole-sitter Lando Norris and convert the advantage into his first Formula 1 victory. The timing proved catastrophic for McLaren, as Norris—who had executed a masterpiece qualifying lap to secure pole—found himself unable to respond before the restart ended his winning chances. Antonelli's breakthrough result cuts into McLaren's championship advantage as Mercedes moves into contention at a circuit that proved treacherous enough to claim Arvid Lindblad in Friday practice.
